name: Find The Celebrities
desc:
Welcome to Find The Celebrities! Search through the map and collect your favorite Celebs!

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden Celebs!
🏃 Rent tools with coins to complete obbies easier
🏆 Find all Celebrities to win!

Some Celebrities are very well hidden. Find the Celebrities with friends and meet new friends along the way!

55 Celebrities
4 Maps
